name: Amemiya Reina
source:
Specialities: studying, sports. She can do pretty much anything.
Weakness: interpersonal relationships
Hobby: reading

The sole daughter of the Amemiya family, the largest landowner in the town of Kanna. An honorable young lady whose father is the member of the parliament, but she dyed her hair upon entering the Kanna Academy. She is the type that hates crowds and loud places, and finds peace in reading books. She hates how she becomes hysteric at a moment's notice and tries to act as rational as she can. Because Reina is the daughter of a wealthy family and because she excels at studying and all kinds of sports, those around her find her difficult to approach and think of her as distant and arrogant, but she indulges in junk food when no one is looking and also collects toys from the meals.

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/reina.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
